desc:
⚽ Build your own football club from nothing and lead it to the top league! 🏆

🛡️ Create your club with your own name, logo, colors and kit, then step onto the touchline as the manager. Pick your formation, choose your starting players and watch every match play out live on your own stadium, with slow motion big chances and goal replays! 🎬

🃏 Open card packs and collect players from common to legendary
💪 Train your players to raise their stats and unlock their potential
🌍 Play live matches against real clubs from every server
💰 Win matches to earn money and fans, and climb through the leagues
🤝 Buy and sell players with everyone on the community market
🕶️ Catch the secret Black Market to sign legendary ICON players
👥 Challenge your friends to friendly matches

🔥 Every club starts small. Will yours become a legend? 🔥

🎁 Codes: WELCOME, KICKOFF
